notes:
ACCESS: reached only through the Claude-in-Chrome connector, in my own tab, no HTTP client of any kind. robots.txt read first: a single 'User-agent: *' block with a short path deny-list (/account, /checkout, /cart, /wishlist, /s/, /h/, /orders/, /api/tracking, ...), no Claude/anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-User directive and no full-site disallow, so category listings are permitted. No 403, no DataDome/Akamai/Cloudflare challenge and no rate-limit was hit at any point (~700 same-origin requests, paced).

TREE: built from https://www.moemax.de/sitemap-categories.xml, fetched by same-origin fetch() from the loaded page: 3,091 <loc> entries, 660 canonical category URLs after stripping query-string facet variants. Every URL carries a hierarchical breadcrumb code '<slug>-C<id>C<id>...' that decodes directly into the site's own tree; 17 top-level departments were enumerated (C30 Moebel, C31 Heimtextilien, C32 Teppiche, C33 Lampen, C34 Kuechen, C35 Kochen & Essen, C36 Aufbewahrung, C37 Deko, C38 Garderoben, C39 Spiegel, C40 Outdoor-Gartenausstattung, C41 Freizeit, C42 Haushaltsgeraete, C43 Weihnachten, C44 Badzubehoer, C45 Garten & Outdoor, C47 Kuechengeraete) and each was inspected for furniture-typed children. This is the same SAP-Commerce-family platform as XXXLutz DE (SR 105) but with a DIFFERENT category-code space, and unlike XXXLutz it has NO material cross-cut department (no 'Holzmoebel' equivalent) - the material cuts here sit as leaf children inside the normal tree instead.

SITEMAP GAP + NAV CROSS-CHECK (trap 1): the sitemap omits several intermediate nodes. The department pages' own sub-category tile strips were parsed for every furniture parent (C30, C30C1, C30C3, C30C4, C30C5, C30C6, C30C7, C30C8, C30C10, C30C11, C34, C38, C45, C46) and the union taken. That recovered four nodes the sitemap does not list - Chairs (C30C1 alt slug), Benches (C30C2), Sofas & Couches (C30C10) and the Kids Furniture department (C46) - and the only other codes the tile strips added were nodes deliberately excluded anyway (C30C9 Matratzen, C30C11C2 TV-Wandhalterungen, C30C7C4C3 Duschablagen, C38C2 Garderobenhaken, C34C6 Kuechenausstattung, C34C3C2 Kochfelder, C45C15 Gartendeko, C45C16 Sonnen-/Sichtschutz, C46C2 Babyzubehoer) plus material/shape facet children. So no furniture branch is missing.

QTY - HOW IT WAS OBTAINED, AND THE TRAP THAT NEARLY BROKE IT: moemax.de is an SPA behind dynamic rendering. A same-origin fetch() with Accept: text/html returns, for MOST category URLs, a 4.2 KB 'JavaScript is required' shell with no data at all - not a block, a render mode. Retrying the same URL immediately (4x in ~6s) does NOT help. What does work is that the first request warms the edge: request a URL once, come back to it a few minutes later, and the server returns the full ~1.3 MB server-rendered HTML embedding __APOLLO_STATE__ with the listing pagination {pageSize, totalPages, totalResults} AND the rendered header markup 'resultCountContainer data-track-value="N"'. The extraction was therefore run as a multi-round warm-then-collect loop (5 rounds, ~1.5-2.5 s between requests): 191 of 194 nodes returned a real SSR render, 225 requests in total. NEVER was a shell recorded as 0.

qty = totalResults, which on this site is identical to the number the page prints in its own header ('60 von 1074 Artikel angezeigt').

SANITY CHECKS: (a) rendered header vs. embedded JSON - data-track-value == totalResults on ALL 191 nodes, 0 mismatches; (b) exhaustion check ceil(totalResults/pageSize) == totalPages passed on ALL 191 nodes, pageSize stable at 60 everywhere (no page-size A/B drift); (c) an independent third read: 18 nodes were also loaded as fully-rendered pages in a same-origin iframe early on and their live rendered headers were compared to the later SSR numbers - all 18 matched exactly (e.g. Klapphocker 5 '5 von 5 Artikel angezeigt', Buerostuehle 1074, Esszimmerstuehle 4902, Sitzbaenke 635, Moebel 159367); (d) the h1 returned with every fetch was checked against the node requested - it matched in every case, so no bad-slug-serves-the-parent substitution (trap 2); (e) counts discriminate strongly between siblings (Stufenregal 3 vs. Boxspringbetten 33431), so no site-wide constant; (f) no suspiciously round display caps.

HIERARCHY: a parent is emitted as a grouping row (qty/link null) when its children are a genuine taxonomy covering a meaningful share of it - verified numerically, e.g. Kommoden & Schubladenschraenke 13258 vs. children 13266 (100%), Betten 58195 vs. 57621 (99%), Schraenke 23134 vs. 23009 (99%), Badezimmerschraenke 5742 vs. 5684 (99%), Buerostuehle 1074 vs. 1051 (98%), Gartenmoebel 3326 vs. 3215 (97%), Sessel 7455 vs. 7079 (95%), Kleiderschraenke 9906 vs. 7977 (81%), Regale 3275 vs. 2714 (83%), Stuehle 12193 vs. 6868 (56%, but the eight children are eight distinct chair types). Where the site's children are only a thin sliver or an overlapping re-cut of the parent, the PARENT is kept as the leaf and the children dropped - stated with the measured ratio: Esstische 5671 (children 3%), Beistelltische 884 (3%), Schreibtische 1872 (14%), Ecksofas 16632 (1%), Schlafsofas 1937 (2%), Gartenstuehle 806 (3%), TV-Moebel 656 (4%), Schuhschraenke 1035 (35%), Gaestebetten 274 (35%), Wandregale 862 (28%), Babybetten 235 (Gitterbetten 78% is the same product type under another name).

DROPPED AS FACET RE-CUTS (never as categories, per the price/colour/material/shape-filter rule): Couchtische rund/eckig/glas/metall/holz/mit-Stauraum/hoehenverstellbar/mit-Rollen; Beistelltische rund/eckig/glas/holz/metall; Esstische rund/ausziehbar/holz/massivholz; the dining-chair form cuts Drehstuehle/Holzstuehle/Schalenstuehle/Polsterstuehle/Schwingstuehle/Armlehnenstuehle; Kleiderschraenke mit Spiegel; Holzbetten and its massivholz/teilmassiv children; Ledersofas; Rattan-Gartenmoebel; Gartenstuehle stapelbar/Hochlehner/Niedriglehner; Gartentische ausziehbar; kleine and XXL Ecksofas; Buerostuehle ergonomisch; hoehenverstellbare Schreibtische and the other desk children.

EXCLUDED PER RULESET: the entire Matratzen tree (C30C9 - mattresses, toppers, mattress protectors, baby/kids mattresses) and Lattenroste (slatted bases); all lighting (C33) and all mirrors (C39); rugs and doormats (C32); all textiles (C31 incl. outdoor cushions and seat pads); decoration, pictures, frames, wall decor, candles, vases, artificial plants (C37); Christmas (C43); tableware, cookware, glassware, kitchen utensils (C35); kitchen worktops, sinks, taps, built-in bins and all kitchen/household appliances (C34C6C1/C3/C4/C5, C42, C47, C34C3 Kochfelder); bathroom fixtures and accessories (C44 - laundry baskets, towel rails, soap dispensers, WC brushes); standalone storage goods - boxes, baskets, hanging organisers, folding boxes, magazine racks, clothes storage (C36); parts and accessories nodes (Schrank-Zubehoer and its Kleiderstange/Einlegeboeden/Schubladen/Aufsatzschraenke children, Schreibtischzubehoer, Schreibtischaufsaetze, Buerostuhlrollen & Bodenschutzmatten, TV-Wandhaltungen, Duschablagen, Garderobenhaken, Wandhaken); garden sheds, garden storage boxes, raised beds, pools, grills, parasols/gazebos/pergolas/privacy screens, garden decor (C40/C45C15/C45C16); camping chairs and tables (C40C16) as gear rather than furniture; toys, play tables, pet supplies, luggage (C41); baby accessories (C46C2).

OVERLAP NOTES: (1) the Kitchens department's own children overlap each other - Kuechenzeilen 3464 + Eckkuechen 460 + Kuechenbloecke mit 2006 + ohne 1176 + Minikuechen 216 + Schrankkuechen 25 + Kuechenschraenke 1155 = 8502 against a parent of 5206 - so these rows must not be summed; they are emitted as the site presents them and every fitted-kitchen row carries a MANUAL REVIEW flag because whether fitted kitchens belong in Furniture is an open project decision (handled exactly as SR 105 XXXLutz DE did). (2) Wohnzimmertische (Living Room Tables, 637) is a separate nav node whose products overlap Couchtische and Beistelltische. (3) Kindermoebel (C46, 923) is a cross-cut kids department overlapping the kids beds/chairs/wardrobes/shelving/tables rows; flagged. (4) Loungemoebel (C45C1), Balkonmoebel (C45C2) and Gartenmoebel (C45C10) are three sibling outdoor departments on the site whose product sets partly overlap; emitted as presented.

ONE NODE COULD NOT BE READ AS A LISTING: alle-schmuckschraenke-C30C6C4 (Jewellery Cabinets) returns HTTP 200 but the browser is redirected straight to a single product detail page, so no listing header ever renders. That is itself the evidence that the node holds exactly one product; it is emitted with qty 1 and a MANUAL REVIEW flag. Two further codes - Benches (C30C2) and Sofas & Couches (C30C10) - also have no listing page of their own; both are grouping rows here, so no qty was needed for either.
